findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: contacts.search, events.list_my_tickets, events.get_my_ticket, organizer.events.get_ticketing_summary, organizer.events.get_support_tickets, organizer.events.get_support_ticket, organizer.support_tickets.list_all · Private data: contacts.search, contacts.get, contacts.list_groups, contacts.get_timeline, contacts.add_note · Public sink: contacts.search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: contacts.search, events.list_my_tickets, events.get_my_ticket, organizer.events.get_ticketing_summary, organizer.events.get_support_tickets, organizer.events.get_support_ticket, organizer.support_tickets.list_all · Private data: contacts.search, contacts.get, contacts.list_groups, contacts.get_timeline, contacts.add_note · Public sink: contacts.search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
